lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2Mg12 (DyMg6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows Dy centers with 16 geometric neighbors (8 Dy, 8 Mg) and Mg centers with 12 neighbors, the latter adopting a close-packed-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Dy and Mg 16- and 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing among Mg 12-vertex polyhedra.
